thesis: Fiscal Q4 beat and outlook (gap 40.48 to 48.90 on 2026-11-11) drove a stacked uptrend backed by accelerating revenue (161.178M, +12.04% YoY), a turn to positive net income and a clean balance sheet (cash 332.7M vs debt 51.9M, low dilution risk), and healthcare is one of the few sectors holding up in the risk-off tape. This is a conditional pullback entry only in 45.0-46.8 (last close 47.09 is above the zone; R/R at the 46.0 midpoint is 3.5, at 47.09 about 2.3), not a chase. Rated Overweight rather than Buy because the regime is risk-off at 0.93 confidence with VIX 31.37, the 11/19 reversal from 49.64 shows supply, and the first resistance at 50.06 offers only about 1.3 R, so the full target depends on a breakout; news items are RSS headlines only, guidance details and the 10-K filed 2026-11-19 were not reviewed.
invalidation: Daily close below 42.9, under the post-gap lows of 43.52 and 43.15, which would fill the 11/11 earnings gap.
